## What it checks (sampled describe/it titles)

- PrintToFusion360Bridge.mergeDetailViews — basic merge semantics

- replaces macro dim when detail dim shares location_hint (case-insensitive)
- appends detail-only dimensions (angular taper not in macro)
- preserves macro dim id when detail replaces it (provenance)
- normalizes whitespace for hint matching (multiple spaces collapse)
